A tropical pink ginger flower bouquet.

What’s even sweeter than that catchy tune: exotic blooms like pink ginger and red cordyline paired with masajeana leaves and more super lush greenery, plus dried okra pods that can be kept for future use. name: Amethyst
description_html:
Dry bouquet that pops with purple orchard grass & gypsophila.

Breathe in, and breathe out, because Amethyst is here to relieve any stress. Symbolizing peace, this dried arrangement of violet baby’s breath, dark green eucalyptus, white bunny tails, and orchard grass is a real gem, as radiant and multifaceted as its namesake. Elevate your space and aura with this luxurious Bouq.

Care Tips: Always be gentle with your dried Bouq, as these flowers are super delicate. Keep out of harsh sunlight and away from humidity to avoid damage and discoloration. Dried Bouqs should never be placed in or near water. A decorative vase works perfectly!

We recommend giving your arrangement an initial trim to fit nicely into your selected vase. Gently remove any dust with a soft brush or feather duster. A hairdryer on low (no heat) will also do the trick!

Please note, dried Bouqs with pampas grass will experience natural shedding.

Due to local restrictions, this Bouq cannot be delivered to Hawaii.
